name: 酒馆
description: 角色扮演：SillyTavern 兼容的角色卡、世界书、预设与人设，在专用面板中开始与继续角色扮演对话。

features.name: 酒馆专用面板：角色、世界书、预设与人设分页管理
features.nameEn: Dedicated Tavern panel with tabs for characters, world books, presets and personas

features.name: 导入、查看与移除 SillyTavern 兼容角色卡（JSON 与 PNG，V1/V2/V3），含头像、全部开场白与完整设定
features.nameEn: Import, view and remove SillyTavern-compatible character cards (JSON and PNG, V1/V2/V3) with avatar, every greeting and the full definition

features.name: 世界书与角色卡内嵌世界信息：关键词与次要关键词逻辑、位置、概率、递归与预算，可设为全局并逐条开关
features.nameEn: World books and embedded world information: keys and secondary-key logic, position, chance, recursion and budget; global books and per-entry switches

features.name: 预设：主提示、段落顺序、作者注释与深度、后置指令、世界书扫描设置，可导入 SillyTavern 预设
features.nameEn: Presets: main prompt, section order, author's note and depth, post-history instructions and world-information scanning; SillyTavern preset import

features.name: 人设：你在故事里的名字与描述，可设为默认
features.nameEn: Personas: your name and description in the story, with a default

features.name: 角色扮演模式：每轮请求按预设重新组织角色、人设与世界书，开场白作为第一条消息，按存档继续
features.nameEn: Roleplay mode: every request is rebuilt from the preset, character, persona and world books, the greeting opens the chat, and playthroughs can be resumed

features.name: 预览提示词与被激活的世界书条目
features.nameEn: Preview the prompt and the activated world entries
